qrTarget.description: Display-only — lets the builder re-show which QR is currently selected when type is 'qr'. Carries no link meaning of its own; `link` (the resolved public short_url) is what the button actually navigates to. Mirrors auto_redirect.json's own qrTarget field.

defaultMessage.description: Always allowed regardless of type — the frontend's own defaults unconditionally include this key (empty string) even when type isn't 'sms'. Declared unconditionally here (not only inside the type==sms if/then below) so unevaluatedProperties:false doesn't reject it for every non-sms button.

layout.description: Declared here (button.json), not _base_button.json — this is the standalone button BLOCK's own appearance, not the nested submit/directions button config _base_button.json is shared by (rsvp/custom_form/file/map), which don't have this field.

cardStyle.description: Card surface material + shadow slot, written by the block's own designFields cardSurfaceField(). Every other block using that preset already declares this; button was missed, so unevaluatedProperties:false rejected any button whose Card Surface was set. Declared here rather than _base_button.json for the same reason `layout` is: the nested submit/directions buttons that shared base describes have no card of their own.
